content: सौम्य {%a.%} (-म्या|-म्यी|{%f.%}) [सोमो देवतास्य तस्येदं वा अण्] .²1 Relating or sacred to the moon. .²2 Having the properties of Soma. .²3 Handsome, lovely, charming; pleasing, agreeable. .²4 Gentle, soft, mild, placid; संरम्भं मैथिलीहासः क्षणसौम्यां निनाय ताम् <ls>R. 12. 36</ls>; सौम्यस्वभावोऽपि पृथुप्रतापः (where सौम्य means both ‘gentle’ and ‘lunar’) <ls>Bu. Ch. 1. 10</ls>; (the <ab>voc.</ab> सौम्य is often used in the sense of ‘good sir’, ‘gentle sir’, ‘good man’; प्रीतास्मि ते सौम्य चिराय जीव <ls>R. 14. 59</ls>; सौम्येति चाभाष्य यथार्थवादी <ls n="R.">14. 44</ls>; <ls>Me. 51</ls>; <ls>Ku. 4. 35</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 25</ls>). .²5 Auspicious. .²6 Bright, brilliant. .²7 Cool, moist. .²8 Northern. .{@-म्यः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Budha or the planet Mercury. .²2 A proper epithet by which a Brāhmaṇa should be addressed; आयुष्मान् भव सौम्येति वाच्यो विप्रोऽभिवादने <ls>Ms. 2. 125</ls>. .²3 A Brāhmaṇa. .²4 The Udumbara tree. .²5 Blood before it becomes red, serum. .²6 The gastric juice. .²7 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the nine divisions of the earth. .²8 An auspicious planet. .²9 A Brāhmaṇa drinking the Soma juice. .²10 A kind of penance (सौम्यकृच्छ्र). .²11 An adherent, worshipper; पपुर्ज्ञानमयं सौम्या यन्मुखाम्बुरुहासवम् <ls>Bhāg. 2. 4. 24</ls>. .²12 The left hand. .²13 The month मार्गशीर्ष. .{@-म्यम्@} .²1 Gentleness. .²2 The मृगशिरस् constellation. .²3 The left eye. .²4 The middle of the hand. .{@-म्या@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²2 The moon-plant. .²3 A pearl. .²4 The मृगशिरस् constellation. .{@-म्यी@} Moon-shine. --{%m.%} <ab>pl.</ab> .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the five stars in Orionʼs head. .²2 A particular class of Pitṛs or Manes; अग्निष्वात्तांश्च सौम्यांश्च विप्राणामेव निर्दिशेत् <ls>Ms. 3. 199</ls>.
